title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: history and rollback doors refuse a bare two-holder name and address one holder by ?package=
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMEcsa8u1Ymjwvb5h8WsfW2)_

epic:#31527#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvyhxPWfA8DsbmVYJ5

Fixes #32905

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches the history or rollback door of a by-package name; the generated API reference carries the new `packageId` field.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同名对象由两个包各持一份时（flow、webhook 等按包存储的类型），History 和回滚不再把两家的版本混在一起；不带包的请求返回 409 并列出两家，带 `?package=` 只读、只回滚那一家的版本。控制台的 History 工具会带上条目页的包。
- 为什么改：实测发现，不带包的回滚会把 beta 的版本写进 alpha 的行（静默选中一家），历史列表把两家的版本当成同一条记录。
- 风险与回滚：只有“两家同时持有同名”时行为才变（原来 200，现在 409）；只有一家持有时完全不变。回滚方式是直接 revert 这个 PR，不涉及数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-slots.ts`（判定规则）和 dogfood 测试 `history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`，7 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，座位按常规流程审核合入。

## What changed

**The rule** (`historySlotOf`, new `protocol-history-slots.ts`), for a type stored per `(package, name)` (`PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`), is the one `DatabaseLoader` already keeps for `MetadataManager.getHistory` / `rollback`:

- **Bare** (no `?package=`): a name whose active rows are held by two or more row slots (two packages', or a package's beside the package-less row) is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `ambiguous-in-environment`, `details.candidates` naming every holder, before any row is read or written. One slot or none: answers as before.
- **`?package=P`** (the `/layers?package=` spelling): the slot of the row a read naming `P` serves (P's own row, or its `.custom` pair's declared override of P), else P's own slot when P ships the name. A package that neither holds nor ships the name is refused `409` `not-held-by-qualifier`.
- History lists that slot's versions only. Rollback restores into that slot's row, and a version of another slot is refused `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND` saying whose it is ("Nothing was restored.").
- A version with no attribution (recorded before this release) belongs to a slot only while the name has no other slot: never guessed with two holders.

**Attribution.** `SysMetadataRepository` (the `/meta` doors' store) now writes `sys_metadata_history.package_id` for by-package types, as `DatabaseLoader` does (`sys_metadata` = the package-less row). `@objectstack/metadata` exports that rule as `historyRowAttribution` / `ENVIRONMENT_HISTORY_MARK` so both writers read one rule.

**Doors.** `GET /meta/:type/:name/history` and `POST /meta/:type/:name/rollback` declare `package` in their closed query sets (`META_ITEM_HISTORY_PARAMS`, `META_ITEM_ROLLBACK_PARAMS`), refuse it repeated, fold `all`/empty to no package (`metaItemPackageBinding`), and render the refusal with `details.candidates` (`packageScopedCandidates`, as the plain read does). For every other type `?package=` is accepted and leaves the answer unchanged.

**Console.** `MetadataClient.history()` / `rollback()` take `packageId` (sent as `?package=`); the History tool sends its item page's `?package=` (routed page), the edit page's history sheet sends `ownerPackageId` (the package its layered read uses), and Studio's item tools send the `packageId` its Layers read already uses.

## Measurement (before the fix)

Posted on the card: 6867256997. On a booted showcase with two `AppPlugin` packages each holding flow `qa_hist_shared`: bare history 200 interleaving both holders' versions; `?package=` 400 (not supported); bare rollback `{toVersion: 2}` (beta's) **200 and wrote beta's body into alpha's row** — a silent pick. Seat regrade: stays p2 (triage 6867291698).

## After the fix (same boot, `history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`)

| Request | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| bare `GET …/history`, two holders | 200, both holders' versions | **409**, candidates both pairs |
| bare `POST …/rollback`, two holders | 200, writes into one holder | **409**, candidates both, neither row changes |
| `GET …/history?package=alpha.custom` | 400 | 200, alpha's versions only (legacy unattributed excluded) |
| `POST …/rollback?package=alpha.custom` to beta's version | 400 | **404**, "belongs to package 'beta.custom'", nothing restored |
| `POST …/rollback?package=alpha.custom` to an unattributed version | 400 | **404**, "attributed to no package … more than one holds the name" |
| `POST …/rollback?package=alpha.custom` to its own version | 400 | 200, only alpha's row changes |
| `?package=com.qa.hist32905.alpha` (the base) | 400 | addresses its pair's declared override, both doors |
| `?package=` a stranger package | 400 | 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` |
| one-holder name, bare (CONTROL) | 200 | 200, whole log, bare rollback works |

## Red lines

1. **Resolution is never loosened.** Nothing that refused before serves now: the bare plain read, `/layers` and every other door are untouched; the new refusals only narrow. `CONTROL: a name one package holds keeps its whole log and its bare rollback, as before` (dogfood), CONTROL — no package, 'all' and the empty string send no 'packageId' (REST), CONTROL: no 'packageId' sends no 'package' key on either door (client) and CONTROL: no '?package=' sends no 'packageId' on either door (console) hold the one-holder and bare spellings unchanged; `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts` stays green with only its measured-set pin taking `package`.
2. **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** `the bare history of the two-holder name is refused 409 naming both holders`, `the bare rollback of the two-holder name is refused 409 naming both, and neither holder's row changes`, `?package= restores only that holder's row; the other holder's version and an unattributed one are refused, writing nothing`, `a package that holds nothing of the name is refused naming the holders` (dogfood); the protocol's two-holder refusal is a 409 naming every holder in 'details.candidates' (REST). An unattributed legacy version is never assigned to a holder while two hold the name.
3. **Every child is independently releasable.** One PR, no migration (no stored shape changes; `package_id` already existed), no dependency on another child's branch; the bare one-holder behaviour is unchanged so it ships alone.

## Ablations

Each leg mutated one source line with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit once; blob change proved; restore to HEAD proved), rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, proved the mutation live in `dist/` with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (exit 0, tree clean), and ran `history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`. After the last leg the full rebuild was proved clean: `ablation-dist-preflight … __ablate32905 --absent` exit 0, and the file is 7/7 green.

| Leg | Mutation (forbidden behaviour put back) | Red (first failure) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| L1 | history skips `historySlotOf` when no package is named | `the bare history of the two-holder name is refused 409 naming both holders`: `expected 200 to be 409` (also the base-package case's bare-409 line) |
| L2 | rollback skips `historySlotOf` when no package is named | `the bare rollback … neither holder's row changes`: `{"success":true,…"restoredFromVersion":1} expected 200 to be 409`; the cascade reddens the two `?package=` cases (the bare write grew alpha's log: `expected [ 1, 3, 6 ] to have a length of 2`) |
| L3 | `isVersionOf` accepts another holder's attributed version | `?package= reads that holder's versions alone…`: `expected [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ] to have a length of 2 but got 4`; `?package= restores only that holder's row…`: cross-holder restore `200` |
| L4 | `isVersionOf` accepts an unattributed version under two holders | `?package= reads…`: `expected [ 1, 3, 5 ] to have a length of 2 but got 3`; `?package= restores…`: `"restoredFromVersion":5` answered `200` |
| L5 | the `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal disabled | `a package that holds nothing of the name is refused naming the holders`: `{"events":[]} expected 200 to be 409` |

## Verification

All on head `1c1a28f9` (after one merge of `origin/main`), each command run with `</dev/null` and its exit code landed on disk first:

- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 123 commands, all exit 0; reconciled with `--ran`: **123 derived, 123 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. Two first-run reds re-run after a fix: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 (shallow clone could not reach its pinned fixture `621a4876`; fetched, then exit 0) and `check:test-source-alias` exit 1 (the edited Studio item-tools pin reaches `import('@objectstack/lint')`; module-top preload added, then exit 0).
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Typecheck: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `rest`, `metadata`, `metadata-core`, `dogfood` — exit 0 each; `rest check:test-typecheck` exit 0.
- Suites: metadata-protocol 337 files / 22803 passed; rest 410 / 8355 passed; metadata 76 / 2296; metadata-core 27 / 1024 (skips are pre-existing, none added).
- Full dogfood battery (owed by the narrowing arm): **463 files passed, 3 skipped; 3915 tests passed, 42 skipped**.
- UI: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/` 120 files / 1379 passed; app-shell item-tools, ResourceEditPage*, ResourceHistoryPage*, StudioDesignSurface.itemTools, metadataAdminFaces: 67 files / 341 passed.
- `check:generated` (with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`; the default heap reports test-typecheck "failed without diagnostics"): green after `gen:docs`.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK, 54 anchors judged, 0 lost. `ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- UI type-check, after building their dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --filter=@object-ui/data-objectstack^...`): `@object-ui/data-objectstack type-check` and `@object-ui/app-shell type-check` (source and test projects) exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Side finding, carried by #32607 (epic:#31527#2), not fixed here.** Reproduction: two writable pairs `com.qa.hist.{alpha,beta}.custom` each `PUT /meta/flow/qa_hist_runtime?package=<pair>` (no `overrides`); bare `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_runtime` answers **200 with alpha.custom's flow**, while the shipped two-holder name answers 409. This PR's history and rollback doors refuse that name bare (they judge the row slots, not the plain read).
- **Out of scope, reported:** `GET /meta/:type/:name/diff?from=&to=` still reads the name's versions across holders (measured: diffs alpha's v1 against beta's v2). It writes nothing; a follow-up can give it the same `?package=`.
- **Out of scope:** `@objectstack/client`'s `getHistory` (the SDK) sends no package; the console uses `data-objectstack`'s client. Other package-scoped types not stored per `(package, name)` (page, dashboard, …) are not addressed by ADR-0150 D3 here and their history door answers as before.
- **Bundle member:** `HistoryPanel` threads no `member` today (pre-existing); unchanged.
- **Surface beyond the order's list, and why:** `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (the two closed query sets live there, route rule 5); `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` plus its generated `authorable-surface/api.json` and `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (`HistoryMetaItemRequest` is the protocol's request type); `packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-history.object.ts` (doc of `package_id` only); `ui/…/StudioItemTools.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (one prop each: the History tool's other two mounts), and `StudioDesignSurface.itemTools-28239.test.tsx` (its history/rollback call pins now carry the `packageId` its Layers pin already did).
- **Rulings on the surface, kept:** `meta-item-history-routes.ts` — 5865708652 (letter B, three sites), 5856774816 (three sites), ruling record 6787890900 (two sites), maintainer ruling 2026-08-22 option B; `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts` — 6116165299 (Q2 i, closed sets). No ruling line is edited or removed by this diff (`git diff` of `ruling|maintainer|⛔` lines: two added `⛔` comments, none removed).
